name: First East Turkestan Republic
native: شەرقىي تۈركىستان ئىسلام جۇمھۇرىيىتى (Sherqiy Türkistan Islam Jumhuriyiti)
东突厥斯坦伊斯兰共和国 (Dōng Tūjuésītǎn Yīsīlán Gònghéguó)
alt: Turkic Islamic Republic of Eastern Turkestan

predecessors.name: Republic of China
predecessors.text: claimed territory stretching from Aksu along the northern rim of the Tarim Basin to Khotan in the south; actual control over the prefectures of Kashgar, Kizilsu, Khotan and Aksu

successors.name: Republic of China
successors.text: claimed territory stretching from Aksu along the northern rim of the Tarim Basin to Khotan in the south; actual control over the prefectures of Kashgar, Kizilsu, Khotan and Aksu

ledger.x: 1933: the Turkic Islamic Republic of Eastern Turkestan is proclaimed at Kashgar.

wars.name: Ma Zhongying's campaign against the East Turkestan Republic
wars.outcome: Ma Zhancang's and Ma Zhongying's Hui troops took Kashgar in February 1934 and destroyed the republic.

certainty.note: A republic of oases with no frontier described on the page.
